verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Open WebUI as a self-hosted AI platform built to run entirely offline, including air-gapped deployments. The GitHub README documents installation via pip, uv, Docker, or Kubernetes (kubectl, kustomize, helm), and community users confirm they run it themselves via Docker, though they complain about large images. Missing for 10: in-depth self-hosting operations docs in the pack (hardware requirements, upgrades), plus the license moving from BSD-3 to a custom branding-retention license, which narrows the openness of self-hosting.
